interactions.target_raw: Guanine nucleotide-binding protein G(s) subunit alpha isoforms short
interactions.note: The epitope of nanobody Nb35 on the ß2AR-Gs-BI-167107 complex was determined from the crystal structure of the complex, solved by molecular replacement. There is one complex in the asymmetric unit. The amino terminus of ß2AR was replaced with T4 lysozyme. The stimulatory G protein heterotrimer (Gs) is composed of bovine Gαs short (chain A), rat Gß1 (chain B) and bovine gamma2 (chain R). Nb35 packs at the interface of the Gß and Gα subunits, with the CDR1 interacting primarily with Gß and a long CDR3 loop interacting with both Gß and Gα subunits.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 3.2 angstroms
